notes.title: Out of Space full release on February 26th!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to move to your new space house!? From the same creators of [b]Chroma Squad[/b], [b]Knights and Galaxy of Pen & Paper[/b], here comes a new challenge!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4653571/7b5e36c0852f9fe30d1a323d9ce927292c6d8b96.png[/img]

Out of Space will be out of Early Access on this February 26th, and we want to have you on board! 

Out of Space is a LOCAL and ONLINE co-op multiplayer game about living together in a house in space. You and your friends are about to move into a house in space, where you will have to deal with a deadly alien infestation and face the challenges of building a sustainable spaceship, all to make your new place feel as cozy as home! A game where COUCH FUN meets STRATEGY.

Check out the trailer and buy the game now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q23FGokrxYk

https://store.steampowered.com/app/400080/Out_of_Space/

Come join our community, get access to games before everyone and give us feedback on what we should focus on! [url=http://discord.gg/beholdstudios]http://discord.gg/beholdstudios[/url]

If you like Friendly Multiplayer Co-op Games, check this 20% discount bundle out! https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13532/Friendly_Coop_Multiplayer_Bundle/

notes.title: Out of Space update: Multiplayer Online up to 4 players! v0.8.01b4
FREE Content Update +1 Edition
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29468051/60ea43b7db2d759587c8a152e742cc6a228c6ee5.png[/img]

Welcome to the new Galaxy of Pen & Paper +1 Edition free content update!

You deserved! Your feedback was amazing and now we get to give you back with this new free update!

- 6 new playable classes: Sniper, Cyborg, Smuggler, Scientist, and two secrets.
- New planets and biomes to explore: Laboratory, Old Tokeeo, Snow, Surreal, and many more!
- 2 new player Races that could change your entire party: Reptoid and Mechan!
- 5 new roleplayers that you can invite to play the game with you: Munchkin, Tragedian, Provider, Explorer and Anarchist.
- Tons of new quests, new NPCs, new bosses, new skills, new legendary items and artifacts!
- Improved balancing and unlocking experience with character Skills.
- Improved event system: now it considers your current quest and the place where you're travelling to.
- A new Achievement, performance improvement and... a lot of bug fixes!
- Many and many hours of gameplay!

Thanks for being with us for this whole time! We love that you're part of our community!

ːsteamhappyː If you want to get closer and see what we're working on, check our discord server at: http://discord.gg/beholdstudios

Cheers! \o/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29468051/f41c302d043793848a47c1022fb7c52e9e50e7f8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: A new patch available! v1.0.3
notes.notes:
It's terrible to have bugs in the game, jeopardizing your experience. But it is awesome to be able to fix those bugs in a short time, and be able to improve the game as you deserve!

🚀  The game is getting better every day 🚀 

Here are the changes made for this patch:

- Fixed repair bot skill.
- Fixed Zappy mission flow.
- Fixed coffee mission.
- Fixed some weaponsmith appearances.
- Fixed space battles XP and Credits.
- Fixed some defeat and event issues after space battles.
- Now you can properly unlock a new mission giver before unlocking its mission type.
- Fixed Collect missions on asteroids.
- Quick fix for players stuck at the end of Ep3.
- Fixed Game Master in Pectoralis Major
- Fixed Achiever passive skill.
- A few resolution fixes.
- Fixed an issue where the game could freeze after a ship was destroyed.
- More small fixes and improvements.

Next week we'll have a new patch!
Cheers

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Yay!

- Fixed Planet Prober achievement progressing with wrong items.
- Fixed mineral quantity and delay issues on planet scan.
- Fixed the game flow if the player is defeated in story space battles.
- Fixed a game freezing bug when a character is ressurected.
- Fixed Slow Status incorrect behavior in some situations.
- Fixed some issues with the Initiative Bar.
- Improved sound on Medbay.
- Fixed wrong NPC which was appearing as a barrel.
- Fixed Hunt mission update step which could be redeemed many times.
- Fixed wrong enemy names on class quest tooltips.
- Fixed a bug where you could have multiple NPCs from class missions.
- Fixed some treasures that would not spawn.
- Fixed some resolution issues.
- Fixed an issue where upgrades could be purchased more than once.
- Quick fix for players who have an intercept mission and are stuck in a loading.
- More bug fixes and improvements

Thanks everyone for your patience. We hope the game becomes even more fun!
